learning_outcomes.text: Explain principles, concepts, notations, methods, and tools for the collaborative, engineering-oriented development of extensive software systems.
Summarize the problems in the development of industrial information systems.
Participate in relevant projects using the learned methods.
Describe a software system using UML.
Recognize various design patterns and explain their purpose.
Work in a team through several phases of software development.
Make decisions regarding relevant and irrelevant properties of software.

syllabus_topics: Functional, operational, and business requirements for software systems
Tool support (CASE tools, version control, diagramming)
Independent acquisition of complex knowledge areas
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded for a passed written examination. The relevance of the grade for the final grade is determined by the Bachelor's examination regulations.
bibliography: Brandt-Pook, H.; Kollmeier, R.: Softwareentwicklung kompakt und verständlich. Springer Vieweg, 2. Auflage 2016
